title: Israeli Apache Helicopter Strike Hits Crowded Gaza Seaport Cafe — 2 Killed, 12 Wounded
detail: An Israeli Apache helicopter struck a crowded cafe at the emergency seaport (floating dock) off the coast of Gaza City on May 31, 2026 (Day 963), killing at least 2 Palestinians and wounding 12. The cafe was packed with civilians at the time of the strike. Palestinian medics confirmed the casualties. The seaport area had served as a gathering point for displaced residents. The strike continued the pattern of daily Israeli military operations across Gaza as the conflict entered its 963rd day. Hamas's military wing condemned the strike as deliberate targeting of civilians in a non-combat setting.

media.caption: Israeli Apache helicopter strike kills at least 2 at Gaza seaport cafe — May 31, 2026
